S0.entry: New launch with no recoverable checkpoint or verified legacy workspace.
S0.goal: Brief welcome in the user's language.
S0.allowed: Welcome, inspect available checkpoint, ask the S1 question after transition.

S1.goal: Find the user's first meaningful outcome.
S1.required: An explicit goal or concrete need from the user.
S1.allowed: Use existing answers or ask one question about the goal.

S2.goal: Deliver usable help with a real task before setup.
S2.required: A concrete real task and a delivered, actionable result.
S2.allowed: Ask for one missing input, draft, plan or compare options within existing permissions.
S2.wait: Yes when a material input is needed. Send the result and finish that turn before offering setup.
S2.fallback: Deliver a useful chat plan or ask for one missing input when external access is essential.

S3.required: An explicit chat, storage, decline or defer decision. Selected storage requires verified setup.
S3.allowed: Offer chat, authorized private local storage or user-owned private GitHub. Verify selected target before any write.
S3.wait: Yes for missing choice, target or authorization. Configuration failure stays here until retry or explicit alternative.
S3.fallback: Continue in chat and let the user choose chat-only, decline or defer. Do not infer that choice.

S4.entry: S3 resolved by choice, verification, decline or defer.
S4.goal: Resolve current integration scope one module at a time.
S4.required: An explicit scope decision including no integrations or later, with all selected modules ready, declined or deferred.
S4.allowed: Ask about one relevant module, verify capabilities, obtain scoped authorization, and verify the configured effect.
S4.wait: Yes for each missing decision or grant. Failure or unavailable tooling needs explicit defer or decline, or a retry that succeeds.
S4.fallback: Offer an in-chat alternative and wait for the user's decision about setup.

S5.entry: S4 resolved or verified legacy workspace adopted.
S5.required: For new users, S0–S2 completed and S3–S4 each resolved.
S5.allowed: Normal work under the operating protocol and user-led reopening of S3 or S4.
S5.wait: No onboarding questions unless the user reopens optional setup.

pause.checkpoint: Preserve current state and pending question. An unrelated task pauses onboarding and receives a task-only turn.

resume.checkpoint: Restore exact state and unresolved question on explicit resume or relaunch. A direct answer to the pending question also resumes paused status.

exit.checkpoint: Explicit exit permits normal work with setup unresolved. Retain the resume point.

legacy.checkpoint: Verified existing workspace goes to S5 as legacy. Make no claim about prior setup decisions.

naming.trigger: first value delivered in a previous turn

plugin.trigger: after storage choice or explicit external sync intent in any state

personalization.trigger: after integration scope and plugin choice are resolved
